name: vidaud
description: VIDAUD - Professional video & audio downloader for Windows
author: VIDAUD

scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/generate-icon.mjs && node scripts/download-binaries.mjs
scripts.clean: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force out,dist -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Cleaned out/ and dist/'"
scripts.package: npm run clean && npm run installer-image && npm run build && electron-builder --win && node scripts/copy-release.mjs
scripts.package:dir: npm run clean && npm run installer-image && npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.dist: npm run clean && npm run installer-image && npm run build && electron-builder --win && node scripts/copy-release.mjs
